title: Track the funnel: where it stops tells you what to fix
takeaway: Silence is not feedback; the stage where your search stalls names the problem, and each stage has a different fix.
sources: Track the funnel, not the outcome.
If you are getting no replies, the problem is upstream - resume or targeting.
If you get screens and no onsites, it is technical preparation.
Different problems, different fixes, and you cannot tell which without the numbers.

stages.label: Applications sent
stages.note: Twenty tailored beat two hundred generic
